Class TransactionService

java.lang.Object
library.service.TransactionService
public class TransactionService extends Object
Service that keeps the persistent transaction log (ADD, UPDATE, DELETE, STATUS_CHANGE, ISSUE, RETURN, RESERVE, CANCEL_RESERVATION) and provides filtered, newest-first views of it.

Usman
